# Tab tooltip validation

A short-named document. The tab strip shows `tab-tooltip.md` in full, so
hovering it raises no tooltip card.

## Mixed content alongside the feature

Dwell over the long-named sibling file (open both to see the tab row):

- [open the long-named file](a-very-long-file-name-that-can-never-fit-inside-a-tab-card-without-the-tooltip.md)
- lists, **emphasis**, *italics*, `inline code`, and > quotes all render
  around the tooltip without stealing the mouse
